## The reels' own examples

* Reel 1 (Fri 4 Sep 2026, NIFTY 23,897.70, VIX 10.68): EM with 2 days = 188.93 (the reel's 188.9); with the 4 calendar days from Friday's close to Tuesday's expiry = 267.18. End-of-day ATM straddle (23950) 174.05 -> x1.25 = 217.56 around 23,963.72. Expiry 2026-09-08 close: 23,635.10.
* Reel 2 (VIX 19, 5 days): the quoted 93% / 96% imply spot 23,709; formula check: P(below 24,500) = 93.0%, P(above 22,800) = 96.1%.
